meta.name: history-portability
meta.description: Import Claude Code or Codex history and move complete CCAM datasets between machines. Use when rescanning provider history, importing a copied directory, uploading JSONL or archives, exporting a backup, restoring it idempotently, or verifying that tokens, workflows, runs, rules, and pricing survived.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 备份并迁移 Claude Code 和 Codex 的历史记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要在多台电脑之间保留 AI 编程助手的使用记录
copy.tagline_en: Back up and migrate Claude Code and Codex history across machines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to preserve AI coding assistant history across multiple computers

howto.what: 装好后你可以让 Claude 导入已复制的历史目录、重新扫描历史或导出备份;也可在另一台机器恢复整套 CCAM 数据,并核对会话数、token、费用等是否完整。
howto.when: 当你说到重新扫描历史、导入已复制目录或导出/恢复备份等操作时触发。

say.text: 重新扫描 Claude 的历史记录。
把这个目录作为 Codex 历史导入。
导出完整备份,并在另一台机器恢复。
say.note: 执行 ccam export 与 import-data

howto.what_en: After installation, you can ask Claude to import copied history directories, rescan provider history, or export a backup; it can also restore the full CCAM dataset on another machine and verify session counts, token totals, costs, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention rescanning provider history, importing a copied directory, or exporting/restoring a backup (and related file/archive uploads or verification).

say_en.text: Import this directory as Codex history.
Export a full backup and restore it on another machine.
